name: 4 Blondes Mahjong
description: Teaching collective. Organizer profile on ma.to: "4 Blondes Mahjong brings American Mahjong instruction, social leagues, and competitive tournaments to community venues throughout San Antonio and beyond". Runs Mahjong 101/102 classes and open play at wine bars and gardens around San Antonio.
address: San Antonio and surrounding area TX
schedule: Events at various venues; see ma.to profile

name: Molly Pruitt Library Mahjong
description: San Antonio Public Library branch hosting American Mahjong open play. Listing text: bring your 2026 NMJL league card and a mahjong set if you have one; library has some sets. Experienced players help beginners. Adults 18+.

name: Albany JCC - Learn to Play Mah Jongg
description: Albany Jewish Community Center offers Mah Jongg classes and drop-in games. Its class page says 'Ready to dive into the addictive and fast-paced world of American Mahj Jongg'; an earlier listing said the class teaches American Mah Jongg with National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) rules and card. Instructors listed: Ruth Malka (2026), Criss Macaione (2024).
schedule: Intermediate class Tuesdays Oct 6-27 2026 1:00-2:30 PM; Mahjong Games drop-in afternoons 1:00-4:00 PM (days not confirmed)

name: Mahjong Mama NWA
description: Founded in Northwest Arkansas by Lindsey Fraser. Teaches American Mahjong using National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) rules; offers private group lessons, public classes and pop-ups, open play, corporate events and Mahj Clubs at Loma (Rogers) and other NWA venues (Bentonville, Fayetteville, Bella Vista, Gravette, Springdale).
address: Loma, 5102 W Pauline Whitaker Pkwy Ste 315, Rogers, AR 72758
schedule: Mahj Club at Loma most Mondays 6-8 PM; Mahjong 101 classes at various NWA venues; 8-week and 6-week hybrid leagues (Holiday Shuffle starts 11/2, $60)

name: Mockingbird & Magnolia Mahjong
description: Bentonville-based American Mahjong hub serving Northwest Arkansas: public classes in Bentonville and Fayetteville, private lessons, open play, social events and set rentals. Described on its site as an American Mahjong hub; the mahjong4friends directory says instruction is based on the National Mah Jongg League card. Based in Bentonville (NWA metro).
schedule: Book classes through the online scheduler on the website
